content.description: Troubleshooting flowchart for rough idling and/or missing symptoms in EFI system. The flowchart shows a decision tree starting with checking diagnosis system, followed by various diagnostic steps including vacuum leaks, air filter, idle speed, ignition timing, spark plugs, and cold start injector. Each step has OK, BAD, or NO outcomes leading to either next step or corrective actions.

steps.action:
CHECK DIAGNOSIS SYSTEM
Check for output of diagnostic code.
(See page FI-22)
CHECK FOR VACUUM LEAKS IN AIR INTAKE LINE

outcomes.action:
1. Oil filler cap
2. Oil level gauge
3. Hose connections
4. PCV hoses
5. EGR system — EGR valve stays open

ISC system
(1) Wiring connection
(2) ISC valve
(3) ECU (test by substitution)

steps.action:
CHECK IGNITION TIMING
1. Short both terminals of the check connector.
2. Check ignition timing.
    STD: 10° BTDC
    (w/short terminals of the check connector)

CHECK SPARK PLUGS
Max. allowable gap: 1.4 mm (0.055 in.)
steps.precaution: Never attempt to adjust gap on used platinum tipped spark plug.
steps.note:
Check compression pressure if necessary.
(See page EM-6)

outcomes.action:
1. Spark plug
2. Compression pressure
    Limit: 9.0 kg/cm² (128 psi, 883 kPa)
    at 250 rpm

steps.action:
CHECK COLD START INJECTOR
(See page FI-43)

outcomes.action:
1. Cold start injector
2. Start injector time switch
(See page FI-71)
